narrative: Page fell from 40270.00 on 10 Aug to 36410.00 on 13 Aug — roughly 9.5% in four sessions, with 121k and 119k shares traded on 13 and 14 Aug against a 10-25k norm. That is an event repricing, not ordinary distribution, and it broke the 39250.00/39485.00 July lows: break of structure down, lower highs and lower lows intact. Today is the counter-rally, +2.4% off 36505.00, and it is being drawn up into the inefficiency the breakdown left behind — an unfilled 1H bearish fair value gap at 38625.00-39100.00 that sits directly under the daily bearish FVG at 38795.00-39735.00 and inside the 62-79% retracement of the whole down leg. The draw after that rebalance is back down to the 36620.00/36410.00 sell-side pool, which has not been taken.
invalidation: A 1H close above 39295.00 puts price through the bearish order block and back inside the pre-breakdown range; above 39735.00 the daily FVG is fully rebalanced and the bearish leg is void. Entry is a resting limit 3.1% above spot — if the counter-rally stalls below 38625.00 there is no trade, and selling here at 37645.00 in the discount half of the range is not part of this plan.
